extracted.name: Fried Dill Pickles
extracted.description: This fried dill pickles recipe dips pickles in milk, Worcestershire sauce, and egg, then coats them in flour before frying them until golden brown.
ingredient_lines: 1 (32 ounce) jar sliced dill pickles, drained
instruction_lines: Combine milk, beaten egg, 1 tablespoon flour, and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl until evenly blended; set aside. Whisk 3 ½ cups flour, salt, and black pepper together in a separate bowl until well combined; set aside.
Heat oil in a deep fryer or deep, heavy skillet to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Dip pickle slices into milk mixture; press into flour mixture until evenly coated.
Cook coated pickles, in batches, in the hot oil until golden brown and float to the surface. Transfer pickles with a slotted spoon to a paper towel-lined plate; drain.
